name: havcserverdit
description: Hybrid Automatic Video Colorizer (HAVC) server that exposes a GPU-accelerated colorization pipeline for B&W images and video frames based on Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (with Nunchaku transformer) and LongCat ImageEdit Turbo. Colorized reference frames are propagated using CMNET2.
